'''Jacques Tilouine''' is a professor of mathematics at [[Université Sorbonne Paris Nord]] working in [[number theory]] and [[automorphic forms]], particularly [[Iwasawa theory]].

==Career==
Tilouine received his PhD in mathematics from [[Paris-Sud University]] in 1989 under the supervision of [[John H. Coates]].<ref name="mathgenealogy">{{MathGenealogy|id=77938}}</ref> He is a professor of mathematics at Université Sorbonne Paris Nord.<ref name="directory">{{cite web|url=https://www.math.univ-paris13.fr/laga/index.php/en/laboratory/organigramme |publisher=[[Université Sorbonne Paris Nord]] |title=Directory |accessdate=3 March 2020}}</ref>

==Research==
Tilouine has worked on the [[Main conjecture of Iwasawa theory|anticyclotomic main conjecture of Iwasawa theory]],<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Hida |first1=H. |author-link=Haruzo Hida |last2=Tilouine |first2=J. |year=1994 |title=On the anticyclotomic main conjecture for CM fields |url=https://link.springer.com/10.1007/BF01232236 |journal=[[Inventiones Mathematicae]] |language=en |volume=117 |issue=1 |pages=89–147 |doi=10.1007/BF01232236 |bibcode=1994InMat.117...89H |s2cid=121368809 |issn=0020-9910|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Tilouine |first=J. |year=1989 |title=Sur la conjecture principale anticyclotomique |url=http://projecteuclid.org/Dienst/getRecord?id=euclid.dmj/1077308162/ |journal=[[Duke Mathematical Journal]] |language=en |volume=59 |issue=3 |pages=629–673 |doi=10.1215/S0012-7094-89-05929-2 |issn=0012-7094|url-access=subscription }}</ref> [[special values of L-functions]],<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Harris |first1=Michael |author-link=Michael Harris (mathematician) |last2=Tilouine |first2=Jacques |year=2001 |title=p-adic measures and square roots of special values of triple product L-functions |url=https://link.springer.com/10.1007/PL00004465 |journal=[[Mathematische Annalen]] |language=en |volume=320 |issue=1 |pages=127–147 |doi=10.1007/PL00004465 |s2cid=123122384 |issn=0025-5831|arxiv=math/9610228 }}</ref> and [[Serre's modularity conjecture|Serre-type conjectures]] for [[symplectic group]]s.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Tilouine |first=J. |year=1989 |title=Sur la conjecture principale anticyclotomique |url=http://projecteuclid.org/Dienst/getRecord?id=euclid.dmj/1077308162/ |journal=[[Duke Mathematical Journal]] |language=en |volume=59 |issue=3 |pages=629–673 |doi=10.1215/S0012-7094-89-05929-2 |issn=0012-7094|url-access=subscription }}</ref>
